description:
Place the prepared order using the merchant's final order control.

With `payment_route: takeover`, this call leaves the order for the user and does not submit it. Finish the available checkout preparation, then report `needs_input` with `reason: payment` and the remaining steps for the user.

Give the control's reference in `submit_ref`, or describe it in `submit_look` when it has no reference. This call uses the recorded purchase and prepared payment. If it returns a virtual credit card instead of submitting, use its number, expiry, CVC and any provided billing address to fill out the checkout form with `browser.act`, just as you would with any credit card. Then call again to submit. Update the recorded purchase with `checkout.prepare` whenever its terms change, including its total. Ask Muse to review material changes with `browser.request_input`, following your checkout instructions.

If the call resumes after an interruption, it continues the same submission. When the page changed and nothing was sent, use the returned view, or observe if none was returned, and name the current control. A submitted or uncertain attempt needs verification on the merchant's site before another purchase is attempted. Read the merchant's result and finish with `browser.report`. Before submitting again after a confirmed failure, record `outcome: not_placed` and its evidence in `summary` through `checkout.prepare`. Include changed purchase terms, or omit purchase inputs for an outcome-only update.

merchant.description: The merchant as the page names it. Null when the page names none, and the page's site stands for it.

account.description: The page's text, or null when the checkout has no place for it or not_applicable lists it.

destination.description: The page's text, or null when the checkout has no place for it or not_applicable lists it.

delivery_service.description: The page's text, or null when the checkout has no place for it or not_applicable lists it.

arrival.description: The page's text, or null when the checkout has no place for it or not_applicable lists it.

contact.description: The page's text, or null when the checkout has no place for it or not_applicable lists it.

payment_method.description: The page's text, or null when the page shows none or not_applicable lists it.

not_applicable.description: The terms the page says do not apply, such as the account in guest checkout. Each term listed here is null in its own field.

page_text.description: The page text that says it does not apply.

variants.description: Each selected variant as Name: Value, such as Color: Blue.

total.description: The displayed amount due now. Record any additional conditional charge separately.

conditional_amount.description: Maximum additional conditional amount for the whole purchase, in the checkout currency. Account for the applicable quantity when a fee is per person or item. Null when unknown or not applicable.

conditional_terms.description: The conditions under which the merchant may collect the additional charge, as stated. Null when unknown or not applicable.

payment_credential_valid_for_seconds.description: Requested Link card lifetime after payment approval, in seconds. Set it for a delayed charge; null uses the default. Keep it unchanged across inspections unless the payment timing changes.

ship_first_name.description: The first name of the shipping address. Shop Pay reads the whole address, from ship_first_name to ship_postal_code.

receipt_identifier.description: The confirmation number on the merchant's confirmation, or null when the page shows none.

receipt_summary.description: What the merchant's confirmation says about the order, in its own words, such as Your order is confirmed. Null when the page shows no confirmation.

payment_route.description: Use wallet for secure payment through Muse Wallet. When a virtual credit card is returned, use its number, expiry, CVC and any provided billing address to fill out the checkout form, just as you would with any credit card. Use merchant_saved for a payment method already stored by this merchant that the user chose, or takeover to prepare checkout as far as possible and leave completion to the user. Takeover returns immediately without payment approval or submission; report the remaining steps when the user must act. Omit only while gathering facts or when no payment method is required.

order_outcome.description: What the merchant's pages show about the order this checkout last submitted. Null when you record none.

order_evidence.description: With order_outcome: what the page shows about the order, in your words. Null otherwise.

saved_card_label.description: How the page names a payment method the merchant holds for the user that this page offers to pay with: a saved card, an account balance, a gift card or store credit, in its own words, such as Visa ending in 4242 or Cash balance. Null when the page offers none.

saved_card_brand.description: With saved_card_label: the card brand the page shows, or null.

saved_card_last4.description: With saved_card_label: the last four digits the page shows, or null.
